title: Can We Read the Mind of an Audio LLM? A Verbalizable, Multilingual Middle-Layer Workspace
abstract: arXiv:2608.24958v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An audio language model is a black box in a specific way: we see what it says, never what it works out on the way there, and chain-of-thought monitoring helps only if the model writes its reasoning down. Reading a base Qwen3-Omni with a logit lens at the audio-token positions, we find that the answer to a spoken question becomes legible - in words - in the model's middle layers, before it emits any token. Five findings follow. (1) The readout carries concepts in neither the question, the options, nor the model's own transcription: on a clip whose verbatim transcription is empty garbling, it reconstructs Watergate and scandal, passes through the role president, and resolves to Nixon - a hidden multi-hop chain, read with no chain-of-thought. (2) The content is language-agnostic: one audio-inferred concept surfaces in several scripts at once, and 38% of top-1 readouts are Chinese on English inputs. (3) It is paralinguistic: given the same

translated_title: 我们能读懂音频大语言模型的“心思”吗？一个可言语化、多语言的中间层工作空间
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24958v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：音频语言模型以一种特定的方式表现为黑盒：我们看到它输出的内容，却看不到它在此过程中推理的过程，而思维链监控仅在模型写下其推理时才有帮助。通过使用logit透镜在音频令牌位置读取基础版Qwen3-Omni模型，我们发现，对于口语问题的答案，在模型发出任何令牌之前，其中间层中就已经以文字形式变得可读。由此得到五项发现：（1）读出内容携带的概念既不在问题中、也不在选项中，更不在模型自身的转录中：在一个逐字转录为空乱码的音频片段上，它重构出“水门事件”和“丑闻”，经过“总统”角色，最终确定为“尼克松”——这是一个隐藏的多跳链，无需思维链即可读出。（2）该内容与语言无关：一个音频推断出的概念会同时以多种文字浮现，且在英文输入上，38%的顶级读出为中文。（3）它是副语言性的：给定相同...
tldr: 本文发现音频语言模型在中间层以可读文字形式提前“思考”答案，且该读出内容具有语言无关性和副语言性，无需思维链即可揭示隐藏推理链。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that audio language models make answers legible as text in middle layers before emitting tokens, with language-agnostic and paralinguistic properties, enabling hidden reasoning chains to be read without chain-of-thought.
